continue.description: Label on the Sign in with ChatGPT SDK button that continues authentication. ChatGPT is a product name and must remain unchanged. This is literal button text: do not add placeholders, markup, or line breaks.

sign-in.description: Label on the Sign in with ChatGPT SDK button that starts authentication. ChatGPT is a product name and must remain unchanged. This is literal button text: do not add placeholders, markup, or line breaks.
